Review Crisp?

Reviewers mostly see Crisp as a capable support tool with strong day-to-day value: reliable chat, useful tags and search, customer context, channel centralization, and good customization come up as clear strengths, with some users also praising its pace of product innovation. But the feedback is not uniformly positive. Others report sharp frustrations with account suspensions, unclear verification blocks, awkward UI actions, and needlessly complex setup for some API and newsletter tasks. The bot, in particular, draws criticism for rigid limits and weak handling of unexpected replies.

We have been using Crisp for several years as our main support tool, and I am extremely satisfied. The product is affordable, the chat works very well, and the tags, search, and customer data panel give us everything we need for excellent customer service. The customization possibilities take the software to another level! So far, my favorite feature has been the centralization of all channels (including WhatsApp!) in one place, but that may potentially change with the announcement of the AI-powered virtual assistant. I can't wait to test it here at the company!

#### What's great

I use Krisp regularly for Zoom, Google Meet and client calls. The noise cancellation works reliably (removes keyboard and background sounds well), accent conversion helps make my speech clearer, and the transcription + summaries save me some time afterwards.

It’s lightweight, runs on-device and doesn’t get in the way. definitely a good, practical one that does the job well.

Would recommend if you’re tired of noisy meetings and messy notes.
